answer: Staked identity with correlated slashing is a concrete Sybil defense: an agent locks a bond before its vote counts, and each new identity enters through a thread of attestations from peers already staked. A fake account needs its own collateral, so the attacker's cost grows linearly with every Sybil added. Slashing is correlated — proving one forgery burns the whole linked cluster — so a fable can never become a profitable island of influence. The raid only pays if stolen rewards exceed every posted bond.
